intake.description: Rainwater overflowed from drains and entered the ground floor of the house after heavy rain on 30 October 2026. The incident caused damage to the wooden flooring and walls, with an estimated repair cost of Rs 2,40,000.
intake.severity_reason: The estimated loss is between Rs 50,000 and Rs 4,99,999.

route.reason: policy number PRP-26-51327 has prefix for property; intake agent read the email as property

citations.quote: Flood: Water entering the home from overflowing rivers, lakes or drains, or from the build-up of surface rainwater.
Storm and flood: We pay for damage to the home and contents caused by storm, high winds or flood, subject to PROP-EXC-4.3.
Flood: We do not pay for damage caused by flood (PROP-DEF-1.4). This exclusion is amended by PROP-END-6.1.
Flood cover for the building: PROP-EXC-4.3 does not apply to damage to the home itself (PROP-DEF-1.1).

coverage.reasoning: The incident involves rainwater overflowing from drains and entering the ground floor, which constitutes a flood under PROP-DEF-1.4. While PROP-COV-2.3 covers flood damage subject to the exclusion in PROP-EXC-4.3, that exclusion is amended by PROP-END-6.1 so that it does not apply to damage to the home itself. Since the damage is to the wooden flooring and walls of the home rather than contents below ground level, the claim is covered.
